bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=13cfc4ef03e74b96795dc4008c94eda4de0a76d1
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
test -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" && test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" || { echo DM_STAGED_SOURCE_MISSING; exit 61; }
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$src" || git cat-file -e "$src^{commit}" || { echo DM_VERIFIED_SOURCE_MISSING; exit 62; }
docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo DM_POLL_IMAGE_NOT_BUILT; exit 63; }
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo DM_POSTGRES_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 64; }
secret_src="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$pg")"
test -f "$secret_src" && test ! -L "$secret_src" || { echo DM_POSTGRES_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE; exit 65; }
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test -n "$user" && test "$net" = deploy_default || { echo DM_POSTGRES_OWNER_MISMATCH; exit 66; }
token_file="$(python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,re,stat,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
matches=[]
folder=Path.home()/'.config'/'create-videobot'
for f in folder.iterdir() if folder.is_dir() else []:
 try:
  s=f.lstat()
  if not stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) or s.st_mode&0o077 or not 35<=s.st_size<=512:continue
  if any(w in f.name.lower() for w in ('session','userbot','phone','oauth')):continue
  token=f.read_text().strip()
  if not re.fullmatch(r'\d{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}',token):continue
  data=json.dumps({}).encode()
  req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/getMe',data=data,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as response: obj=json.load(response)
  me=obj.get('result') or {}
  if obj.get('ok') is True and me.get('is_bot') is True and str(me.get('username','')).lower()=='createvdobot':matches.append(str(f))
 except Exception:continue
if len(matches)==1:print(matches[0])
PY
)"
test -n "$token_file" || { echo DM_CREATOR_TOKEN_NOT_VERIFIED; exit 67; }
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
old="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' || true)"
if test -n "$old";then
 test "$old" = "$name" || { echo DM_OTHER_CREATOR_CONSUMER_RUNNING; exit 68; }
 if docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then
  echo DM_POLL_ALREADY_RUNNING_AND_READY=PASS
  exit 0
 fi
 echo DM_EXISTING_CONSUMER_NOT_READY_NO_DUPLICATE
 exit 69
fi
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token_file"
export VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$secret_src"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" config --quiet || { echo DM_COMPOSE_CONFIG_INVALID; exit 70; }
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-creator-compose.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build videobot-poll >"$log" 2>&1;then
 echo DM_POLL_COMPOSE_START_FAILED
 grep -Eio 'Error response from daemon|invalid mount config|not found|no such image|network .* not found|permission denied|failed to (create|start)' "$log" | sort -u | head -n 5 || true
 exit 71
fi
sleep 7
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" != true;then
 echo DM_POLL_CONTAINER_NOT_RUNNING
 docker logs --tail 30 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(=|$)' | tail -n 8 || true
 exit 72
fi
if ! docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then
 echo DM_POLL_READY_NOT_VERIFIED
 docker logs --tail 30 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(=|$)' | tail -n 8 || true
 exit 73
fi
echo DM_POLL_CONTAINER=RUNNING
echo DM_POLL_READY=PASS
docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_(DM|GATE|POLL)_' | tail -n 10 || true
